codeReview.summary: Well-implemented feature covering all required functionality. PDFAttachments provides drag-and-drop upload with file picker fallback, attached PDF list with name/size/remove, and preview dialog with iframe and download. SubjectLineGenerator generates context-aware subject lines from promotion entries with dropdown selection, editable input, character count badge, and regenerate. Both integrate cleanly into PromotionPage via Zustand store. Code quality is solid with proper error handling, accessibility attributes, and 47 comprehensive tests. A few non-blocking observations noted.

issues.description: processFiles success toast logic: if some files in a multi-file batch are duplicates (skipped with warning) but others succeed, the success toast still fires for the full batch. The hasErrors flag only tracks validation/read errors, not duplicate skips. This is a minor UX inconsistency — the toast could say 'X of Y PDFs attached' when some were skipped as duplicates.

The processFiles useCallback depends on [store] which is the entire Zustand store object. This will cause the callback to be recreated on every store state change (any field), not just when attachedPDFs changes. Consider destructuring or using store.attachedPDFs directly for a more stable dependency. In practice, this is unlikely to cause issues since processFiles is only invoked by user actions, not as an effect dependency.

The subject-line-generator.ts file contains both subject line generation logic AND PDF utility functions (formatFileSize, validatePDFFile, readPDFAsDataURL, dataURLtoBlob). The file name suggests only subject line generation. The PDF utilities would be better placed in a separate file like src/lib/pdf-utils.ts for clearer organization. The PDFAttachment component imports from this file, which is confusing.

PDF ID generation uses Date.now() + Math.random(). In a rapid batch upload scenario, Date.now() could be the same for multiple files. Math.random() reduces collision risk but it's still theoretically possible. Consider using crypto.randomUUID() if available, or a simple incrementing counter.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker created PDF utilities (formatFileSize, validatePDFFile, readPDFAsDataURL, dataURLtoBlob) in subject-line-generator.ts alongside subject line generation logic. This is a naming/organization issue that could confuse future workers. A convention note about file naming would help.

IndexedDB functions (savePDFToIndexedDB, deletePDFFromIndexedDB) in src/lib/db.ts are tested via vi.mock in component tests. The db.ts module was created in a prior feature. Future workers should know that db.ts exists and contains both PDF and bulk email IndexedDB operations.

summary: Feature 'promotion-pdf-and-subjects' passes review. All required functionality is implemented: PDF drag-and-drop upload with file picker fallback, attached PDF list with name/size/remove, PDF preview in shadcn Dialog with iframe and download button, subject line generation from promotion content, shadcn Select dropdown, editable input with character count Badge, and regenerate button. Both components use the Zustand store and IndexedDB persistence as specified. Code is well-structured with proper error handling, accessibility (role, tabIndex, aria-label, htmlFor), and cleanup (URL.revokeObjectURL). 47 tests cover pure functions, component rendering, and user interactions. Minor non-blocking observations about file organization and callback dependency specificity noted.
